title: Data and actions
summary: Use the read-only information API, signed exchange actions, and reconnect-safe streams as separate parts of the application.

links.description: Query market metadata, books, fills, orders, and user state without signing.
Reference signed orders, cancels, transfers, API-wallet approvals, builder actions, and response shapes.

title: Signing and precision
summary: These references cover the mistakes that most often cause rejected actions or incorrect account queries.

links.description: Match the two signing schemes, MessagePack field order, normalized numbers, and lowercase addresses exactly.
Design unique per-signer nonces and separate agent wallets across concurrent processes and subaccounts.
Round prices and sizes to the protocol's significant-figure and asset-decimal rules before signing.
Resolve different encodings for native perps, HIP-3 perps, spot pairs, tokens, and testnet assets.
